title: Saint Oren's Shade
summary: The group reaches Saint Oren's, a settled community built directly around a massive exposed structure most travelers would call a Sunforge. Nobody assigns Brandon another identity.

panelPlan.text: The settlement wraps naturally around a huge black ribbed structure used for shade, tables and a children's climbing boundary. No one treats it as sacred or technical.
Kayla Simmons welcomes the travelers, asks their actual names and writes them on a meal board.
Eva watches Brandon's name remain Brandon through an entire introduction.

title: Samuel Stays
summary: Samuel learns that Alec Damon, an elderly community member, is dying and has been asking for someone willing to sit with his estranged daughter. Samuel asks the group to stay a few days.

panelPlan.text: Before anyone decides how long the stop will be, Samuel asks for time. Alec lies in a bright back room with family moving normally around him rather than posing in vigil.
Kayla tells Samuel that Alec's daughter refuses to enter because their last conversation ended badly.
Samuel asks Jessie whether the group can remain while Alec's family moves quietly in the room behind him.

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: I need a few days here. I'm asking before I decide for everybody.

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: Alec Damon is dying. His daughter won't come inside.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: And you think you can fix that?

title: Day Two
summary: A second uneventful day makes Eva restless and Raina methodical. Brandon becomes legible through ordinary behavior: he loses at cards, helps Alec outside, and knows exactly as much about the mystery as he claimed.

panelPlan.text: Day two begins with Eva explicitly counting the consequences of Samuel asking them to stay—and Brandon losing again. Montage-like sequential page: Brandon loses coins at a card table and looks genuinely annoyed; later he helps Alec sit under the black Sunforge rib.
Eva notes every absence of recognition while Raina checks old guest books for similar faces or names.
Jessie catches Eva watching Brandon laugh at a bad joke and asks what theory that supports.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Day two. He asked, we stayed, and Brandon lost again.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: I thought he'd be good at cards.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Nobody here has mistaken him for anybody.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: Nobody here has had time. They're busy beating him.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: So am I. You keep waiting for something strange and missing how bad he is at losing.

title: Raina's Empty Page
summary: Raina cannot make Saint Oren's fit her emerging correlation. The largest and most obvious Sunforge-like structure they have encountered produces no identity event, no unusual arrival and no Cadre convergence.

panelPlan.text: Jessie's 'There. Progress.' is answered by Raina asking Eva to make some progress on the Sunforge question. Raina sits beneath the black structure with maps and notes spread around her, drawing lines and then crossing them out.
Eva offers increasingly broad theories. Jessie asks whether Raina may have grouped unlike things under one name.
Brandon passes with a tray of food, listens to three sentences and declines to join.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: Then help me make some. If the structure matters, this should be the loudest place we've seen.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: The people here don't even use these things the same way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: Fine. That still doesn't make them one thing.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: What would convince you they aren't the same thing?

title: Alec's Last Evening
summary: Samuel helps Alec and his daughter speak before Alec dies. The issue's emotional center belongs entirely to people whose lives have nothing to do with Brandon's mystery.

panelPlan.text: Kayla's first remark is that Samuel missed the stew Brandon had just offered elsewhere in the settlement. Samuel sits between Alec and his daughter only long enough to get them speaking directly to each other, then moves his chair back.
Brandon, Eva and Jessie remain outside with Kayla, giving the family privacy and talking quietly about ordinary things.
Later, Samuel emerges and says Alec died after midnight. Nobody asks whether the Sunforge had anything to do with it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kayla Simmons
dialogueInline.text: I know. Did they make peace?

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: They finally said what they were angry about.

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: A little. That's all they had time for.

title: Four Quiet Days
summary: After four quiet days, the group leaves Saint Oren's with no anomalous event to explain. The negative case matters: an obvious Sunforge and Brandon can coexist without the pattern appearing.

panelPlan.text: Eva turns four quiet days into a deliberately ordinary inventory—coffee, cheating, cards—before Raina calls the stop uneventful. The group says goodbye after Alec's simple burial. Kayla calls each traveler by the correct name.
Eva looks back at the enormous black structure and closes her notebook rather than adding another theory.
On the road, Jessie lists ordinary things they learned about Brandon. Brandon objects only when she gets to his card playing.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Four days. What did we learn?

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: I know. I didn't like it.
